title: Proposal for Association for Intermediate and Long-term Care Institutions
what_it_is: Proposal for Association for Intermediate and Long-term Care Institutions

sections.label: Representative bodies in ILTC sector
sections.summary: Representative bodies organise such efforts, sometimes with MOH and AIC, including the Singapore Hospice Council and the Association of Private Nursing Home Operators.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Today, there are already representative bodies that organise such efforts, sometimes in collaboration with the Ministry of Health (MOH) and the Agency for Integrated Care (AIC).

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Examples include the Singapore Hospice Council and the Association of Private Nursing Home Operators.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: In addition, most of the voluntary welfare organisation (VWO) providers in this sector are members of the National Council of Social Service (NCSS).

sections.label: AIC standards and shared services
sections.summary: AIC has promulgated standards, convened industry committees, and brought providers together for economies of scale, with plans to extend shared services.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: In recent years, AIC has promulgated standards, such as the Enhanced Nursing Home Standards and Guidelines for Home and Centre-based Care, and convened industry committees to develop strategies and initiatives in quality improvement and manpower development.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: AIC has also brought providers together for better economies of scale in areas, such as procurement of consumables and organisation of transport services, and intends to extend this to new shared services, such as security and waste management.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: We will continue to assess how we can better promote the interests of the Intermediate and Long-Term Care (ILTC) sector and to raise the level of industry practices and professionalism of ILTC sector workers.

sections.label: No ILTC association yet
sections.summary: MOH felt it is probably not the right time to have an ILTC association, with AIC as sector developer and coordinator helping operators level up.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: Indeed, she is right that there is a bit of unevenness amongst the various providers.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: That is why MOH felt that it is probably not the right time to have an ILTC association as such.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: With AIC being the sector developer and coordinator, we are able to help each and every individual operator to level up.
